text:
alina: Quick design check: rollout list rows feel cramped when allocations, tags, and timestamp are all shown. want to reduce visual noise.

rita: What about collapsing allocation badges into one "Allocations: 3" pill that expands on hover/focus to show percentages? keeps row tidy.

matt: Agree, but scrubber overlay currently steals pointer events from badges. we should lower scrubber z-index and only enable pointer-events when hovered.

sam: Accessibility: pill must be a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Enter/Space toggles breakdown; focusable for keyboard users.

noah: Contrast issue: small colored badges fail 4.5:1. propose either darker tokens or white bg + colored text for badges. I'll ping design tokens.

alina: Good. Rita can mock compact (one-line) and relaxed (two-line) layouts and include pill focus/expanded states. Matt to update prototype z-index/tab order. Sam to draft a11y snippet for dialog and pill.

ux-bot: Reminder: upload mocks and a11y spec before next planning. checklist: mocks, a11y, copy, QA steps. :spiral_note_pad:

rita: I'll add CSS samples (pill styles + focus outline) and show keyboard flow. targeting Monday review.
